idea.title: Five ways to end a call
idea.summary: Five types at the very end of a call, opened on a concrete 'said bye 4 times' moment, ending on the viewer and a this-or-that.
hookOptions: Five people who can't say bye
Confession: I say bye six times

scenes.say: I said bye four times. Still talking.

scenes.title: 5 ways calls end

items.title: The 'okay bye' times six
items.line: Says bye, then one more question. Bye. Wait, actually.

items.title: The 'anyway...' one
items.line: Says anyway like a closing door, then stays ten more minutes.

items.title: The mid-laugh hang-up
items.line: Your best joke lands. Call ends. No notes.

items.title: The 'you first' one
items.line: Both waiting. Nobody moves. The timer keeps going.

items.title: You, after the bye
items.line: Still on the call, reading this card instead of hanging up.

scenes.cta: send to who never hangs up
scenes.say: Bye, bye, bye. Anyway. Mid-laugh click. You first. Then there's you.

scenes.question: Who hangs up first?
scenes.say: Who hangs up first? Me, every time, or never me?

scenes.ask: Which one are you: bye x6 or you first?

post.caption:
Five people at the end of every call. You're at least two of them.
Which one are you: bye x6 or you first? Send this to the friend who never hangs up.
Talk to someone new at randomtalker.com (link in bio).
